reason: Machine lens: every opcode is plain 6502 (TXA, LDY #, LDA #, STA (zp),Y, INY), all real on the 65SC12. Drawn path: STX zp (3) and LDA zp (3) go, TXA (2) comes: 4 cycles saved; the four moved instructions cost the same before or after the call. Bytes: -2 -2 +1 = -3. The refused path (BCS unsafe, or BCC called not taken after in_hazel) now pays the two stores: +17 cycles, never taken in the profile. Layout from build/strykers.lst: code before BEQ in_hazel grows by 8 and .called's part shrinks by 11. BEQ in_hazel goes to 9D04 (next 9D06) with target 9D23, the same page; before, 9CFE to 9D26 crossed a page, so the taken HAZEL path saves 1 more. BCC on_page, BCS unsafe and BCC called stay on one page, and all are in range. Everything in bank 4 after 9D05 moves down 3, up to B36F, ck_index (A3B2 to A3AF) and the other ck_ tables with it. A shift of -3 makes a table read cross more often only if the base's low byte is 00-02: no indexed operand in the listing has such a base in the moved range, and ck_index's crossings fall (Y &4E-&50 stop crossing). A scan of every branch in the moved range finds two that change, which the candidate missed: BPL each_part (9DFF, restore_block) stops crossing, -1 a pass for each taken loop (9.8 cycles a pass now). BNE out at record_differs' first compare (9FFE) starts crossing when taken, but by the window annotation (5.1 cycles over about 2.5 executions) it is effectively never taken. Net layout is a small gain. Semantics checked: X still holds the kind for the ck_ table reads, since TXA keeps X. None of the 14 compiled kinds reads Y before loading it (scanned src/compiled_*.6502), so entering them with Y = 9 is harmless. The kinds and compiled_call touch only &C0-&C3, PLAYER_SAVE, the screen and ROMSEL, never v_ptr, the arena or ACCCON, so the early stores hit the same bytes. A kind's unsafe exit writes nothing. ck_kind has no other reader (grep). On the refused path, kc_part (SKY_HELI=0) and draw_column (ds_clip = 0 here) write v_ptr+8/+9 before restore_block can read them, and when every column is empty the block ends at v_ptr+8, so those bytes stay outside it. They are within the room the drawn path already used from the same v_ptr. C stays clear at .called for ADC #11.
